images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished landscape background illustration for an Ohio travel and culture website, not a UI mockup. Create exactly one wide 3:2 landscape image, preferably 1536x1024. Sophisticated Japanese anime environment illustration with beautiful finely painted surfaces, crisp line detail, atmospheric light, and clean readable silhouettes. Pale blue light, deep navy accents, controlled vivid coral highlights. Fill the entire frame with the illustrated scene; no white border, no empty studio background. Arrange the specified objects in distinct generously spaced regions with enough uncluttered surfaces around them for later HTML hotspot placement. No hotspots or interface elements should be drawn. Absolutely no people, characters, faces, text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, signage, captions, watermarks, borders, or split panels. No letters even on book spines or records. Output one single finished image. Primary request: elevated oblique illustrated miniature Ohio landscape/map world. Broad shimmering Lake Erie inspired lake coast spans the upper-left, a compact handsome midwestern city skyline occupies upper-right, a wooded winding river and layered sandstone gorge with a small waterfall occupy lower-right, rolling green farmland and wooded hills occupy lower-left. A river visually connects the regions. Rich blue lake, leafy green forests, limestone sand and tiny coral roof accents. No literal state outline required; this is an inviting imaginative coherent continuous landscape, not a geographic diagram. Elevated three-quarter view of an expansive world, detailed anime background painting. Clear readable land regions and harmonious depth.
